title.zh: Anthropic IPO 文件中的五个奇怪细节
title.en: Five weird details from Anthropic’s IPO filing

current_state.zh: Anthropic已向SEC提交S-1，计划在纳斯达克上市，IPO可能最早于11月中旬进行，并披露了上半年营收、净亏损、现金状况及潜在融资和估值报道。
current_state.en: Anthropic has filed an S-1 with the SEC for a Nasdaq IPO expected as early as mid-November, disclosing H1 2026 revenue, net loss, cash position, and reports of a potential raise and valuation.

updates.title_zh: AI 公司 Anthropic 宣布 IPO，预计最早于 11 月进行
updates.title_en: AI company Anthropic announces IPO, expected as early as November
updates.what_changed_zh: 新增披露：Anthropic的S-1拟在纳斯达克全球精选市场上市，股票代码ANT，IPO可能最早于11月中旬进行；同时披露2026年上半年营收超160亿美元、净亏损800亿美元、持有超1120亿美元现金及等价物，并有报道称最高拟融资1000亿美元、估值2万亿美元。
updates.what_changed_en: Added details: Anthropic's S-1 targets a Nasdaq Global Select Market listing under ticker ANT, with an IPO possibly as early as mid-November; it disclosed more than $16B in H1 2026 revenue, an $80B net loss, more than $112B in cash and equivalents, and reports of a potential $100B raise at a $2T valuation.
updates.current_state_zh: Anthropic已向SEC提交S-1，计划在纳斯达克上市，IPO可能最早于11月中旬进行，并披露了上半年营收、净亏损、现金状况及潜在融资和估值报道。
updates.current_state_en: Anthropic has filed an S-1 with the SEC for a Nasdaq IPO expected as early as mid-November, disclosing H1 2026 revenue, net loss, cash position, and reports of a potential raise and valuation.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Anthropic filed an S-1 with the SEC for a Nasdaq IPO expected as early as November, disclosing more than $16 billion in first-half 2026 revenue and an $80 billion net loss amid reports of a potential $100 billion raise at a $2 trillion valuation.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Anthropic filed an S-1 with the SEC for a Nasdaq IPO expected as early as November, disclosing more than $16 billion in first-half 2026 revenue and an $80 billion net loss amid reports of a potential $100 billion raise at a $2 trillion valuation.
